name: Chicken Biryani
description: Aromatic spiced rice dish with tender chicken, layered with fried onions and herbs.
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger garlic paste, biryani masala, and salt for 30 minutes.
Soak basmati rice for 20 minutes and parboil until 70% cooked.
Fry sliced onions until golden brown and set aside.
Cook marinated chicken with tomatoes until tender and gravy thickens.
Layer parboiled rice over chicken, top with fried onions and mint leaves.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 20 minutes.
Gently mix and serve hot with raita.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Colorful stir-fried rice with mixed vegetables and mild seasoning.
steps: Cook rice and spread on a tray to cool completely.
Heat oil in a wok and sauté chopped onions until translucent.
Add diced carrot, beans, and capsicum; stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add cooled rice, soy sauce, and salt.
Toss on high heat for 4-5 minutes until evenly mixed.
Serve hot as a main dish or side.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Classic fried rice with diced chicken, vegetables, and soy sauce.
steps: Cook rice and let it cool to room temperature.
Dice chicken and cook in oil until golden and cooked through.
Scramble eggs in the same pan and set aside.
Sauté onions and carrots until slightly soft.
Add rice, chicken, eggs, soy sauce, and salt.
Stir-fry on high heat for 5 minutes and serve.

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Quick and easy fried rice with scrambled eggs and spring onions.
steps: Cook rice and cool completely.
Beat eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble in hot oil.
Sauté chopped onions until soft.
Add rice, scrambled eggs, soy sauce, salt, and pepper.
Toss well on high heat for 4 minutes.
Garnish with spring onions and serve.

name: Kottu
description: Popular Sri Lankan chopped flatbread stir-fry with vegetables and spices.
steps: Cook chicken with curry powder and salt; shred into small pieces.
Chop roti into thin strips.
Heat oil on a flat griddle and sauté onions, carrots, and leeks.
Add shredded chicken and chopped roti.
Crack eggs into the mixture and chop everything together using metal blades.
Season with curry powder and salt, toss for 5 minutes, and serve hot.
